claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Live-CLI revalidation on 2026-09-23 — this run's runner has the `claude` CLI installed and `claude --version` reports `2.1.281 (Claude Code)`, matching the target exactly. `validated_against` and `latest_known` both advance from 2.1.280 to **2.1.281** together (no divergence). Reviewed the full published 2.1.281 changelog entry for catalog surface. Adopted/documented: `claude plugin update` now resolves the scope a plugin is installed at when `--scope` is omitted instead of assuming user (fixes project-scoped plugins) — documented in the install guide's Update section; the new `claude plugin validate` checks (a warning when a shell-form hook leaves `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` unquoted, MCP server checks on `.mcp.json` for silently-dropped entries, undeclared `${user_config.*}` references and insecure URLs, and no longer flagging `privacyPolicyUrl`/`supportUrl`/other listing metadata as unknown `plugin.json` fields) — documented in `docs/agent-guidelines/testing.md` and the install guide, and used to audit the three catalog plugins' own repos (findings recorded in the PR, not changed here because no plugin source lives in this catalog). Reviewed and found no catalog surface: this repo ships no `hooks.json`, `.mcp.json`, or `plugin.json` (checked with a repo-wide `find`), and its manifests carry no `privacyPolicyUrl`/`supportUrl` workaround to remove; `claude plugin validate --strict .` on the marketplace manifest passes with no findings. Also reviewed with no action needed: `--plugin-dir` on a folder holding a `marketplace.json` (this repo is installed via `marketplace add`, not `--plugin-dir`), `--channels` plugin-name matching, `claude plugin uninstall` project-scope fix, the `known_marketplaces.json` refresh-recording fix, `"attribution": false` in `settings.json` (this repo commits no Claude Code settings and its commit convention keeps the `Co-Authored-By` trailer), `--agents` JSON-file support and empty `prompt` (no custom subagents here), `mcp_tool` hooks on blocking events waiting for MCP connect (no hooks here), `/batch` with WorktreeCreate hooks, skills shown by short name in `/skills`/`/context`, and the gateway (`assume_role`, `guardrail`, `telemetry.resource_attributes`), auto mode, session-resume, prompt-cache, vim-mode, `/plugin` UI, and platform-specific (VSCode/web/Claude Tag/Code Review) items — all host/session/UI-side. `make validate`, `make validate-skills` (`claude plugin validate --strict --json .agents/skills`), and `scripts/check-platform-targets.sh --assert-current` were re-run against the live 2.1.281 CLI on 2026-09-23 and passed clean. Prior verification (2026-09-22): 2.1.280 was confirmed live and reviewed for the 2.1.278 → 2.1.280 delta (Claude Opus 5.5 default and list mouse support; the `installed_plugins.json` commit-staleness fix, documented in the install guide's Update section; the `manifest.json` skill-trash fix, noted in `docs/agent-guidelines/security.md`; terminal-UI icon fixes) — see the install guide's per-version sections for full history.

cursor.supported_min_source: Cursor documents no minimum version for plugins; the floor is the version actually validated rather than guessed. The previous 0.45.0 floor predates Cursor's plugin system entirely
cursor.verification_method: latest desktop build from official Cursor download links (3.18.9, 2026-08-30 stable) cross-checked against cursor.com/changelog (feature 3.11; date-only entries through 2026-09-02 Self-Hosted Machines / Team Pools / partner sandboxes / computer use); team-marketplace import is a Dashboard flow

codex.supported_min_source: earliest release this catalog has claimed .agents/plugins/marketplace.json support for
codex.verification_method: documentary revalidation by this repo's standing Codex method (official release notes plus catalog compatibility review; the Codex CLI is not installed on the review machine). Reviewed every openai/codex release from 0.148.0 through 0.153.4 for plugin/marketplace changes: #41208 (0.151.0) reports invalid project marketplaces without hiding valid plugins, #41953 (0.153.0) enforces a marketplace source policy for OpenAI-curated plugins only, and #42149/#42150 (0.153.0) upgrade Git marketplaces from merged configuration and add remote-marketplace support to the plugin CLI. None alter the portable Agent Plugin catalog shape, so .agents/plugins/marketplace.json remains discoverable unchanged; 0.153.0 widens how it can be consumed rather than narrowing it.

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: `opencode --version` on the maintainer machine (reported 1.18.29); latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — skill discovery is verified directly with `opencode debug skill`, pointing `skills.paths` at this repo's `.agents/skills` and confirming `run-plugins-catalog` resolves to its `SKILL.md`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
